name: System Language Discovery via Chained Systeminfo and Disk Enum Registry Query
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:cmd.exe AND (process.command_line:*systeminfo* AND process.command_line:*reg* AND process.command_line:*Disk\\Enum*)) OR (event.code:1 AND process.name:reg.exe AND (process.command_line:*HKLM* AND process.command_line:*Disk\\Enum*) AND process.parent.name:cmd.exe))

name: SAM Registry Hive Dumping via Reg Save Command
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND (process.name:(*reg.exe* OR *cmd.exe*))) AND (process.command_line:*reg\ save* AND process.command_line:*HKLM*) AND (process.command_line:(*HKLM\\sam* OR *HKLM\\SAM* OR *HKLM\\system* OR *HKLM\\SYSTEM* OR *HKLM\\security* OR *HKLM\\SECURITY*)) AND (NOT process.parent.name:wbengine.exe))

name: HideFileExt Registry Modification via reg.exe
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:reg.exe AND (process.parent.name:(*cmd.exe* OR *powershell.exe*))) AND (process.command_line:*HideFileExt* AND process.command_line:*\/d\ 1* AND process.command_line:*Explorer\\Advanced*))

name: System Network Connections Discovery via Chained CMD Commands
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.parent.name:(*cmd.exe* OR *powershell.exe*)) AND (process.name:(*netstat* OR *net1*)) AND (process.command_line:(*\-ano* OR *sessions*)))

name: PowerShell Launching .bat/.cmd File via Start-Process or Invoke-Expression
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:powershell.exe AND (process.command_line:(*Start\-Process* OR *Invoke\-Expression*))) AND (process.command_line:(*.bat* OR *.cmd*)))

name: Msiexec Silent Install from Non-Standard Path via CMD
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:*msiexec.exe AND process.parent.name:*cmd.exe) AND (process.command_line:*\/q* AND process.command_line:*\/i*) AND (NOT (process.command_line:(*C\:\\Program\ Files* OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)* OR *C\:\\Windows\\ccmcache* OR *C\:\\Windows\\ccmsetup* OR *C\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start\ Menu* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Installer*))))

name: Remote System Discovery via Net View with Domain Enumeration
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:net.exe AND process.command_line:*view*) AND (process.parent.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe)) AND (NOT winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:System))

name: SAM Registry Hive Dumping via Reg Save Command
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND (process.name:(*reg.exe* OR *cmd.exe*))) AND (process.command_line:*reg\ save* AND process.command_line:*HKLM*) AND (process.command_line:(*HKLM\\sam* OR *HKLM\\SAM* OR *HKLM\\system* OR *HKLM\\SYSTEM* OR *HKLM\\security* OR *HKLM\\SECURITY*)) AND (NOT process.parent.name:wbengine.exe))

name: Domain Group Enumeration Chain via Net.exe at High Integrity
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:(*net.exe* OR *net1.exe*)) AND (process.command_line:(*group\ \/domain* OR *domain\ admins* OR *enterprise\ admins*)))

name: File and Directory Discovery via Recursive Dir and Tree Commands
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:cmd.exe AND (process.command_line:*dir* AND process.command_line:*\/s* AND process.command_line:*\>\>*)) OR (process.name:tree.com AND process.command_line:*\/F*))

name: Registry Query Against HotPatch Key by Non-SYSTEM User
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:reg.exe) AND (process.command_line:*query* AND process.command_line:*HotPatch*) AND (NOT winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:System))

name: PowerShell Spawning Reconnaissance Commands
query: Channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational AND (EventID:1 AND (ParentImage:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\powershell_ise.exe)) AND (Image:(*\\whoami.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\wmic.exe)))

name: Cmdkey Credential Store Followed by MSTSC RDP Lateral Movement
query: EventID:1 AND (((event.code:1 AND process.name:cmdkey.exe AND (process.command_line:(*\/generic\:TERMSRV\/* OR *\/pass\:*))) AND (process.parent.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe))) OR ((event.code:1 AND process.name:mstsc.exe AND process.command_line:*\/v\:*) AND (process.parent.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe))))

name: CMD Chaining Multiple Network Discovery Utilities - T1016
query: EventID:1 AND (((process.parent.name:cmd.exe AND winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:High) AND (process.name:(*ipconfig.exe* OR *arp.exe* OR *nbtstat.exe* OR *netsh.exe* OR *net.exe*))) OR (process.parent.name:cmd.exe AND (process.command_line:*ipconfig* AND process.command_line:*netsh* AND process.command_line:*arp*)))

name: Masquerading System Utilities via Path Mismatch or Suspicious Parent
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:(*whoami.exe OR *hostname.exe OR *svchost.exe OR *taskhostw.exe OR *smartscreen.exe)) AND (NOT (process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*))))

name: PowerShell IEX Remote Download Targeting Office Macro Execution via raw.githubusercontent.com
query: EventID:1 AND (process.name:powershell.exe AND (process.command_line:*IEX* AND process.command_line:*iwr* AND process.command_line:*raw.githubusercontent.com*) AND ((process.command_line:(*Invoke\-MalDoc* OR *Invoke\-Maldoc* OR *T1204.002*)) OR (process.command_line:(*officeProduct* OR *macroFile* OR *Word* OR *Excel* OR *macrocode*))))

name: Scheduled Task Creation via Schtasks with Logon or Startup Triggers
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:schtasks.exe) AND process.command_line:*\/create* AND (process.command_line:(*\/sc\ onlogon* OR *\/sc\ onstart* OR *\/sc\ onstartup*)) AND process.parent.name:cmd.exe)

name: Suspicious sdbinst.exe Execution
query: EventID:1 AND process.name:sdbinst.exe

name: Windows Credential Manager Injection via cmdkey.exe for RDP Lateral Movement
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:cmdkey.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*\/generic\:TERMSRV* OR *\/pass\:*)))

name: Process Discovery via Scripting Interpreter - whoami and hostname Execution
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND (process.name:(*whoami.exe* OR *HOSTNAME.EXE*))) AND (process.parent.name:(*powershell.exe* OR *cmd.exe* OR *wscript.exe*)) AND (NOT process.parent.name:*explorer.exe*))

name: PowerShell Process Injection via Invoke-MalDoc and Raw GitHub Payload Fetch
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:powershell.exe) AND (process.command_line:*Invoke\-MalDoc* AND process.command_line:*T1055* AND process.command_line:*raw.githubusercontent.com*) AND winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:High)

name: Suspicious sdbinst.exe Silent Background Shim Database Installation with Registry Writes
query: (EventID:(12 OR 13 OR 14)) AND ((event.code:13 AND (registry.key:(*SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\SdbUpdates* OR *SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\ NT\\CurrentVersion\\AppCompatFlags\\Custom*))) AND (process.name:sdbinst.exe AND (process.command_line:*\-m* AND process.command_line:*\-bg*)) AND (NOT (process.parent.name:(TrustedInstaller.exe OR MsiExec.exe OR msiexec.exe))))

name: HideFileExt Registry Value Set via reg.exe
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:reg.exe AND (process.command_line:*HideFileExt* AND process.command_line:*Explorer\\Advanced* AND process.command_line:*\/d\ 1*)) AND (process.parent.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe)) AND (NOT winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:System))

name: Archive Utility Spawned by CMD or PowerShell for Data Staging
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.parent.name:(*cmd.exe* OR *powershell.exe*)) AND (process.name:(*Rar.exe* OR *7z.exe* OR *zip.exe* OR *WinRAR.exe*)) AND ((process.command_line:*\ a\ * AND process.command_line:*\-r*) AND (process.command_line:(*%USERPROFILE%* OR *\\Users\\*))))

name: Local Account Discovery via whoami and hostname Spawned by Scripting Engine
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.name:(*whoami.exe* OR *hostname.exe*)) AND (process.parent.name:(*powershell.exe* OR *wscript.exe* OR *cscript.exe* OR *mshta.exe* OR *python.exe* OR *pwsh.exe*)))

name: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest Download to Temp Directory
query: EventID:1 AND (((process.name:(*\\powershell.exe OR *powershell.exe)) AND (process.command_line:*Invoke\-WebRequest* AND process.command_line:*OutFile*) AND (process.command_line:(*$env\:TEMP* OR *%TEMP%* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming* OR *\\Users\\Public* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Temp*)) AND (process.command_line:(*raw.githubusercontent.com* OR *http\:\/\/* OR *https\:\/\/*))) OR ((process.name:(*\\powershell.exe OR *powershell.exe)) AND dns.question.name:raw.githubusercontent.com))

name: PowerShell SMB Mapping via QUIC Transport with Certificate Check Disabled
query: EventID:1 AND ((event.code:1 AND process.name:*powershell.exe*) AND (process.command_line:*New\-SmbMapping* AND process.command_line:*TransportType* AND process.command_line:*QUIC* AND process.command_line:*SkipCertificateCheck*) AND (process.command_line:(*copy* OR *Copy\-Item* OR *cp\ *)))

name: Domain Trust Discovery via Net View Command Chaining
query: EventID:1 AND ((process.parent.name:(*cmd.exe* OR *powershell.exe*)) AND process.name:net.exe AND (process.command_line:*view* AND process.command_line:*\/domain*))

name: Registry Run Key Persistence via reg.exe (T1547.001)
query: EventID:1 AND (process.name:reg.exe AND (process.command_line:*ADD* AND process.command_line:*CurrentVersion\\Run*) AND (process.parent.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe)) AND (NOT (process.command_line:(*C\:\\Windows\\* OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR *C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\*))))

name: PowerShell Spawning Reconnaissance Commands
query: Channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Sysmon\/Operational AND (EventID:1 AND (ParentImage:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\powershell_ise.exe)) AND (Image:(*\\whoami.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\wmic.exe)))
